overview: SubjectScore is a professional email subject line analyzer for TIGOY.com that scores subject lines in real-time across spam risk, readability, and engagement potential, helping email marketers craft high-deliverability subject lines.
features: Real-time scoring engine with spam detection, power word recognition, and length optimization
SVG speedometer gauge animating from red to green as score improves
Word heatmap highlighting spam words (red), long words (yellow), power words (green)
Live inbox preview mockups for iPhone and Outlook
AI alternative generator suggesting 3 better subject line versions
A/B testing simulator comparing two subject lines side-by-side
History tracking of last 5 tested subject lines via localStorage
Top and bottom advertisement banners loaded dynamically from external URLs
Navigation and footer links to partner sites
